description: Dunit musl port (M6) fs: write path — buffered stdio over the native Write syscall. userspace/ctests/musl_stdio.c calls printf()/fflush(); musl's __stdio_write has no writev on Dunit, so the port drains the stream with per-buffer Write. Proves formatted output works through the ported libc. Run: tools/qemu_test.py --build --markers-file tools/m6_musl_stdio_markers.json --post-boot-delay 3 --settle 4 --cmd-timeout 40 --timeout 160 --boot-timeout 100

required.claim: the system booted to the terminal
printf -> vfprintf -> __stdio_write -> native Write produced correctly formatted output through the ported libc
stdio buffering + fflush + a clean return all work on the Dunit port
